description: This file defines a complex React component for a sidebar UI, including context providers, toggle functions, and various subcomponents such as headers, footers, menu items, and buttons. It implements sidebar behaviors like collapsibility, mobile responsiveness, and keyboard shortcuts.

methods.name: useSidebar
methods.description: Custom hook to access the SidebarContext within sidebar components, throws an error if used outside the context.

methods.name: SidebarProvider
methods.description: React component providing sidebar state management and context for nested components, handling open/close logic, cookies, and keyboard shortcut for toggling.

methods.name: Sidebar
methods.description: Main component that renders the sidebar UI, with responsiveness for mobile and desktop, including collapsible and variant options.

methods.name: SidebarTrigger
methods.description: Button component to toggle the sidebar open or collapsed state.

methods.name: SidebarRail
methods.description: Button component positioned as a rail to toggle the sidebar, mainly for hover or quick toggle interactions.

methods.name: SidebarInset
methods.description: Main content container for inset variant of the sidebar.

methods.name: SidebarInput
methods.description: Styled input component designed to be used inside the sidebar.

methods.name: SidebarHeader
methods.description: Container component for the sidebar header area.

methods.name: SidebarFooter
methods.description: Container component for the sidebar footer area.

methods.name: SidebarSeparator
methods.description: Visual separator component inside the sidebar.

methods.name: SidebarContent
methods.description: Wrapper component for the main scrollable content area of the sidebar.

methods.name: SidebarGroup
methods.description: Component for grouping related sidebar items.

methods.name: SidebarGroupLabel
methods.description: Label component for sidebar groups, supports child slot.

methods.name: SidebarGroupAction
methods.description: Button component for actions within a sidebar group, supports child slot.

methods.name: SidebarGroupContent
methods.description: Container for the content inside a sidebar group.

methods.name: SidebarMenu
methods.description: Component for rendering a list of menu items in the sidebar.

methods.name: SidebarMenuItem
methods.description: List item component for individual menu items.

methods.name: SidebarMenuButton
methods.description: Button for sidebar menu items, supports tooltip and active state.

methods.name: SidebarMenuAction
methods.description: Button for actions in sidebar menu, with optional hover show behavior.

methods.name: SidebarMenuBadge
methods.description: Badge component for sidebar menu items.

methods.name: SidebarMenuSkeleton
methods.description: Placeholder skeleton for loading sidebar menu items.

methods.name: SidebarMenuSub
methods.description: Sublist of menu items inside a sidebar menu.

methods.name: SidebarMenuSubItem
methods.description: Item within a sidebar menu sublist.

methods.name: SidebarMenuSubButton
methods.description: Clickable button inside submenu, supporting active state and size variants.
